scope: Live in-app browser UI checks of current source assets; rendered report and production hosting checked by parent task.

checks.name: HY relevant gene guide
checks.observed: 10 named measured-gene buttons; Tll1 primary FDR, Fosl2 and Nr4a3 correctly exploratory.

checks.name: HY unmeasured primary hits
checks.observed: Expanded table: 20 priorities, 10 measured; Hipk3, Ksr2 and other absent genes have profile links and no 3D action. All 11 primary HY FDR hits visible.

checks.name: Gene annotation switching
checks.observed: Tll1, Fosl2, Egr2, Fosb and C730002L08Rik display distinct curated products/functions and NCBI links.

checks.name: Noncoding annotation
checks.observed: C730002L08Rik explicitly ncRNA, no protein assigned; function unknown is stated.

checks.name: Three-gene comparison
checks.observed: Removed Nr4a3, added Egr2; table returns to three genes and Add disabled at maximum. Includes primary/exploratory evidence, BH q, shrunken effect, all-cell detection and mean.

checks.name: ACA source region and effect
checks.observed: ACA navigation loads 14,582 cells. Fosb default: q=2.27e-19, shrunken log2FC=0.997, multiplier=1.996, 1,418 detected cells.

checks.name: ACA independent animals
checks.observed: 4 PBS and 4 PM; source samples Control5, Control6, Control7, Control8, PMA2775, PMA2776, PMA2778, PMA2779 all present with values.

checks.name: Bilingual navigation
checks.observed: Spanish HY→ACA and ACA→English use correct local paths. English ACA text, product, n=8 and PBS n=4/PM n=4 correct.

checks.name: Anatomical focus and camera
checks.observed: Whole-brain focus and ACA focus/reset work. A real reference-scene drag visibly rotates both panels together. Numerical camera queue races additionally covered by six unit tests.

checks.name: Zero filter and scale
checks.observed: Hide-zero changes displayed Fosb cells to 1,418 while three-gene regional summaries remain unchanged. Both 3D panels use same gene-specific color scale and explicit simulation label.

checks.name: Iframe height computation
checks.observed: Intrinsic main rect height, repeated equal heights deduplicated, no document scrollHeight or accumulating iframe offset. Main ResizeObserver and details/comparison changes report updated intrinsic height.

checks.name: Browser logs
checks.observed: No warnings or errors returned for ACA after interaction.
